mapper.insert: INSERT INTO operation_log (user_id, username, module, operation, method, params, ip, duration, status, error_msg, create_time) VALUES (#{userId}, #{username}, #{module}, #{operation}, #{method}, #{params}, #{ip}, #{duration}, #{status}, #{errorMsg}, NOW())
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM operation_log WHERE create_time < DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY)
